description.zh:
指定返回通道的数量。  
取值：大于0小于等于1000  
默认值：1000
description.en:
Specifies the number of tunnels to be returned.\
Valid values: 0 - 1000.\
Default value: 1000.

description.zh:
设定从该marker之后列举通道。  
默认值：无
description.en:
The marker after which tunnels are listed.\
By default, this parameter is left empty.

descriptions.zh: - 列举通道，您必须有mgw:ListImportTunnel权限。
descriptions.en: *   To query a list of tunnels, you must have the permission on mgw:ListImportTunnel.
